name: sitemap-urls-extractor
title: Sitemap URLs Extractor: Every URL, lastmod, Images, Hreflang
description: Every URL from the sitemaps of many websites in one run. Finds sitemaps through robots.txt and the usual paths, follows indexes, reads XML, gzip, text and RSS/Atom. One row per URL with lastmod, changefreq, priority and source sitemap. Filters by pattern and date.
